name: S.S. Robert Lawrence
about: S.S. Robert Lawrence (2020-011A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2020 Feb 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2020 Feb 16), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
